item.title: Effective Pattern for Handling Dialog Closing Events in C# ViewModels
item.description:
“Effective Pattern for Handling Dialog Closing Events in C# ViewModels”

When developing user interfaces involving modal dialogs or pop-up windows, how does the parent ViewModel cleanly receive notification about the dialog’s dismissal, particularly when a specific result (like OK or Cancel) needs to be relayed back? Several expert approaches exist for decoupling the dialog management from the consuming view model.

Method 1: Employing Custom Event Arguments for Direct Result Passing

A direct and straightforward mechanism involves extending the standard EventArgs to carry the necessary return value. This keeps the communication tightly scoped to the specific dialog request.
